aircraft_registration: Romanian aircraft registration: YR- and three letters, like `YR-ABC`, four digits for gliders and ultralights, like `YR-1234`, or YR-D and four digits for drones.
bic: BIC (SWIFT code) of a Romanian bank: four letters, RO and two letters or digits, with an optional three-character branch code, like `RNCBROBU` or `BTRLRO22`.
cnp: Romanian personal numeric code (CNP, cod numeric personal): 13 digits for sex and century, birth date, county and serial, like `5900101123454`; only real dates and county codes.
company_name: Romanian company name: capitalized words, also in quotes, followed by S.R.L., SRL-D, S.A., S.N.C., S.C.S., S.C.A., PFA, I.I. or I.F., like `S.C. Alfa Beta S.R.L.`, or PFA and the owner's name, like `PFA Popescu Ion`.
cui: Romanian company tax code (CUI, CIF, cod fiscal) after its keyword, which is part of the match: up to ten digits, with or without RO, like `CUI 12345674` or `C.I.F.: RO 12345674`.
ecli: European Case Law Identifier (ECLI) of a Romanian court decision: ECLI:RO:, the court, the year and the number, like `ECLI:RO:JDS4B:2017:001.004053`.
iban: Romanian IBAN: RO, two check digits, a four-letter bank code and 16 letters or digits, with or without spaces, like `RO49 AAAA 1B31 0075 9384 0000`.
iccid: SIM card number (ICCID) of a Romanian SIM: 8940 followed by 14 to 16 digits, without spaces, like `8940011234567890125`.
id_card_number: Romanian identity card number (seria și numărul buletinului): a two-letter county series and six digits, with an optional nr. between them, like `RX nr. 123456` or `XB123456`; only existing series.
imsi: IMSI (subscriber identity on a SIM) of a Romanian network: mobile country code 226 and 12 more digits, 15 in all, like `226011234567890`.
license_plate: Romanian license plate (număr de înmatriculare): county code, two digits and three letters, like `CJ-12-XYZ`, or B for Bucharest and two or three digits, like `B 123 ABC`.
mobile_number: Romanian mobile number (număr de mobil): 07 and eight digits, or +40 or 0040 and 7, with spaces, dots, slashes or dashes, like `0722.123.456`; only valid Romanian mobile numbers.
mrz_id_card: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a Romanian identity card: the electronic card's first line (ICAO TD1, `IDROU...`) or the second line of the older card's 36-character zone, with ROU.
mrz_passport: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a Romanian passport, second line (ICAO TD3): 44 characters with the passport number, ROU as nationality, date of birth, sex and expiry date.
msisdn: Romanian mobile number in MSISDN form, as in telecom records: 40 and the number without its 0, 11 digits like `40722123456`; only valid Romanian mobile numbers.
passport_number: Romanian passport number (număr de pașaport) after pașaport or passport (with nr. or no.), keyword included in the match: eight or nine digits, like `pașaport nr. 051234567`.
phone_number: Romanian phone number (număr de telefon): 0 and nine digits, landlines like `021 123 4567` or `(0264) 123 456` and 07 mobiles, also with +40 or 0040; only valid Romanian numbers.
postal_code_city: Romanian postal code (cod poștal) and town: six digits and the place name, like `400001 Cluj-Napoca` or `010011 București`.
premium_number: Romanian premium-rate number: 090x and six digits, national or with +40 or 0040, like `0900 123 456`; only valid Romanian numbers.
street_address: Romanian street address (adresă): Str., Bd., Calea, Șos., Al., Piața, Splaiul or Intrarea, the name and number, with bl., sc., et. and ap. if given, like `Calea Victoriei 155`.
trade_register_number: Romanian trade register number (număr de ordine în Registrul Comerțului, ONRC): the old form `J40/1234/2020` or the 2024 one like `J2025000001004`, for the J, F and C registers.
vat_number: Romanian VAT number (cod de TVA): RO and the CUI of six to ten digits, with or without a space, like `RO12345674`.
